definitions: In J.R.R. Tolkien's fictional world, the nine most powerful of the Nazgûl, who were mortal men corrupted by Sauron's Rings of Power.
Also known as the Nazgûl or Black Riders, they are spectral servants of the Dark Lord Sauron, bound to his will and seeking the One Ring.
examples: The Ringwraiths pursued Frodo and his companions relentlessly.
Nine Ringwraiths appeared on the bridge.
The sound of the Ringwraiths' cries struck fear into many.
